editable_workflow.note: Cloud has no local editable/API file split. The reopenable canvas lives in the Cloud workspace (open it in the Comfy canvas or via get_workflow_canvas_url). The repo API JSON below is the source of truth for automation.

comfyui.local_install: none — Comfy Cloud cannot drive a local ComfyUI; there is no /object_info, no local model dir, no VRAM figure

environment.local_gpu_irrelevant: GTX 1650 4GB — NOT used; all generation runs on Comfy Cloud

model_stack.sha256: not_calculated — model is hosted on Comfy Cloud, not local

model_stack.license: unknown — verify at the Civitai source before commercial release; do not infer from filename
model_stack.sha256: not_calculated — model is hosted on Comfy Cloud, not local

locked_components.vae_source: checkpoint VAE (node 4 output 2) — SDXL base bundles its VAE; no separate VAE loader
locked_components.node_wiring: do not re-route links without re-validation

test.preview_interpolation: nearest (PIL, deterministic, done locally after download)
test.validation_result: dry_run: validated, 0 warnings; estimate_credits: 0 paid API credits (OSS model, GPU-time only)

known_limitations: Background rendered near-white despite a 'magenta key-color' prompt — SDXL pixel models tend to ignore background color. Deterministic background removal / alpha extraction is a separate later post-processing stage, not part of v1.0.0.
Pose read front-facing rather than strictly right-facing; directional control is a v1.1 concern (prompt tuning or ControlNet).
The 64x64 preview is a nearest downscale for pixel-level review only — it is NOT an approved final sprite. Human pixel cleanup / palette enforcement still required.
Model SHA-256 not computed (models are hosted on Comfy Cloud, not on the local disk).
